[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.String

def implementation (a b: String) : String :=
let len := a.length;
let result := String.mk len '0';
let mut i := 0;
while i < len do
  let i_pos := String.Pos.mk i;
  let a_char := a.get i_pos;
  let b_char := b.get i_pos;
  if a_char = b_char then
    result := result.set i_pos '0'
  else
    result := result.set i_pos '1';
  i := i + 1;
result
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma string_xor_get_set
(a b: String)
(i: Nat)
(i_pos: String.Pos)
(h_i_in_bounds: i < a.length)
: (a.get i_pos = b.get i_pos → (implementation a b).get i_pos = '0') ∧
(a.get i_pos ≠ b.get i_pos → (implementation a b).get i_pos = '1') :=
by
unfold implementation
have h_i_in_bounds': i_pos = String.Pos.mk i := by
  simp [i_pos]
  simp [h_i_in_bounds]
have h_len_eq := String.length_eq_of_pos_eq h_i_in_bounds'
have h_result_len_eq := String.length_eq_of_pos_eq h_i_in_bounds'
simp [h_len_eq, h_result_len_eq]
simp [implementation]
simp [h_i_in_bounds]
by_cases h_a_b_eq: a.get i_pos = b.get i_pos
-- case where a.get i_pos = b.get i_pos
simp [h_a_b_eq]
apply And.intro
simp [h_a_b_eq]
apply And.intro
intro h_a_b_eq
simp [h_a_b_eq]
-- case where a.get i_pos ≠ b.get i_pos
simp [h_a_b_eq]
apply And.intro
intro h_a_b_neq
simp [h_a_b_neq]
apply And.intro
simp [h_a_b_neq]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation a b
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_a_all_1s_or_0s := a.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
have h_b_all_1s_or_0s := b.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
have h_a_len_eq_b_len := a.length = b.length
have h_result_len_eq := result.length = a.length
simp [h_a_all_1s_or_0s, h_b_all_1s_or_0s, h_a_len_eq_b_len, h_result_len_eq]
have h_result_all_1s_or_0s := result.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
simp [h_result_all_1s_or_0s]
have h_i_lt_len := i < a.length
have h_i_pos := String.Pos.mk i
have h_get_i_a := a.get h_i_pos
have h_get_i_b := b.get h_i_pos
have h_get_i_result := result.get h_i_pos
have h_result_eq_a_b_xor := implementation.string_xor_get_set a b i h_i_pos h_i_lt_len
have h_a_b_eq := h_result_eq_a_b_xor.left h_get_i_a h_get_i_b
have h_a_b_neq := h_result_eq_a_b_xor.right h_get_i_a h_get_i_b
have h_result_eq_a_b_xor' := And.intro h_a_b_eq h_a_b_neq
simp [h_result_eq_a_b_xor']
[END]
